statements.impact_statement: PROVEN false positive: 13.2.1 is the fixed release. GHSA for CVE-2025-59250 lists the 13.2 range as '>= 13.2.0.jre11, < 13.2.1.jre11', first patched 13.2.1.jre11. The .jre11 suffix is the JRE build flavour, not a version step, and Metabase's jar records the artifact as version=13.2.1 in META-INF/maven/com.microsoft.sqlserver/mssql-jdbc/pom.properties. Trivy then compares 13.2.1 against 13.2.1.jre11 and finds it lower. Scoped to 13.2.1; any other mssql-jdbc version must be re-checked.
